## Decide Who May Do What

Allocate authority and determine which operations require notice, approval,
timely override, prohibition, expiry, or revocation.

Record the authority map, consent boundaries, intervention path, retention
rights, revocation behavior, and exit policy.
:::

::: {.callout-lab}
## Take Away Permission

Exercise approval, override, revocation, inspection, and forgetting as system
operations. Measure completion where timing matters and diagnose one failed path.
:::
